catalog.method: GET fixed URL; strip spaces/newlines; Base64 -> modified XXTEA (delta 0x9E5729B1, key Princie!) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: Server often closes the connection mid-body (16 KiB multiples); script retries then resumes by ranges. hxt:// exists only as a dead literal in the app (no parser, no clipboard read); no text decoder delivered.

files.method: hex -> repeated XOR with 12-byte key -> JNI modified UTF-8 (CESU-8) -> JSON; protections checked after decryption
files.notes: Key verified byte-for-byte against TRM's own libputils.so (.rodata 0xc4d24); self-test 5/5. No real .hxt from a phone yet. Same .hxt family format/key as HX Tunnel VPN and TRV TUNNEL (which already claims hxt in its manifest).
